    Half-year Financial Report

    AI SummaryClose X

    Aquila European Renewables PLC reported a significant decrease in net assets to EUR 146.1 million as of June 30, 2026, down from EUR 279.3 million in the prior year, reflecting a managed wind-down and EUR 54.4 million in capital distributions to shareholders. The company's net asset value per share fell to 38.6 cents from 73.9 cents, and the share price discount to NAV widened considerably to 54.4% from 15.3%. The decline in value is attributed to increased portfolio discount rates and reduced forecast power prices, particularly in the Iberian solar market. Despite operational performance at The Rock wind farm being above budget, overall electricity production was down 19.4% year-on-year, with solar PV output significantly impacted by market conditions. The company continues to explore the sale of its remaining assets, acknowledging that future disposals may not achieve current NAV valuations.

    Disclaimer*
